name: Machine Learning
description: Supervised and unsupervised learning with scikit-learn: regression, trees, ensembles, SVMs, clustering and the math underneath.

items.title: scikit-learn User Guide
items.description: The authoritative guide to the Python ML toolbox.

items.title: Hands-On Machine Learning — Géron
items.description: Practical ML with scikit-learn, Keras and TensorFlow.

items.title: Andrew Ng — ML Specialization
items.description: The most popular introductory ML course in the world.

lessons.title: What Is Machine Learning?
lessons.description: Define machine learning, contrast it with rules-based programming, and survey where ML wins in production.

lessons.title: Types of Learning
lessons.description: Supervised, unsupervised and reinforcement learning — and the sub-tasks that fall under each.

lessons.title: The Learning Problem
lessons.description: Formalize what a model learns: features, targets, hypotheses and loss — the vocabulary of every ML paper.

lessons.title: The Python ML Stack
lessons.description: Get fluent with scikit-learn: estimators, fit/predict, pipelines, and the dataset zoo used everywhere.

lessons.title: Linear Regression
lessons.description: The workhorse of prediction: least squares, multiple predictors, and interpreting coefficients.

lessons.title: Gradient Descent
lessons.description: The optimization loop under every model: compute the gradient, step downhill, repeat.

lessons.title: Logistic Regression
lessons.description: Probability for classification: the sigmoid, log loss, and decision boundaries that stay interpretable.

lessons.title: Decision Trees
lessons.description: Greedy splits, impurity, and why trees are the most interpretable nonlinear models.

lessons.title: Ensemble Methods: Bagging & Random Forests
lessons.description: Combine many weak models into one strong predictor with bagging and random forests.

lessons.title: Gradient Boosting
lessons.description: Boosted trees — the tabular-data champion — fit sequentially to the mistakes of previous models.

lessons.title: Support Vector Machines
lessons.description: Max-margin classification, the kernel trick, and when SVMs beat other models.

lessons.title: K-Nearest Neighbors
lessons.description: The simplest nonparametric model: predict by voting among the closest training points.

lessons.title: Naive Bayes
lessons.description: Bayes' rule applied to text and beyond — fast, simple, and shockingly effective on the right problems.

lessons.title: Feature Scaling & Selection
lessons.description: Prepare features so models learn well: scaling, encoding, selection, and dropping noise.

lessons.title: Regularization
lessons.description: Penalize complexity: L1 and L2 regularization, and the bias-variance trade-off made concrete.

lessons.title: Cross-Validation
lessons.description: k-fold cross-validation gives a more honest error estimate than a single split — and catches tuning leaks.

lessons.title: Hyperparameter Tuning
lessons.description: Search parameter space systematically with grid, random and Bayesian strategies — without leaking into the test set.

lessons.title: Classification Metrics Deep Dive
lessons.description: Precision, recall, F1, ROC curves and calibration — choose the metric that matches the business cost.

lessons.title: K-Means & Clustering
lessons.description: Cluster unlabeled data with k-means, pick k responsibly, and interpret clusters as business segments.

lessons.title: Dimensionality Reduction with PCA
lessons.description: Project high-dimensional data onto its principal components — for visualization, denoising and speed.

lessons.title: Machine Learning Roadmap
lessons.description: Synthesize the course, plan the next projects, and chart the path into deep learning and production ML.
